description: 東京都土砂災害危険度情報関連データ [landslides and debris flows and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 東京都建設局. 【東京都建設局河川部】東京都土砂災害危険度情報において用いる土砂災害警戒区域・特別警戒区域、1kmメッシュ及び監視対象地区の位置・範囲等を示すGISデータです。. Coverage: Tokyo, Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 東京都建設局. It offers 3 resource(s) in shp. The portal shows 2026-07-16 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
